devious_padlock.description: The padlock is made in such a way that the wearer cannot remove it on their own. In the padlock settings you can add notes and configure access rights. By default these padlocks are disabled and cannot be used on you, but you can always change it :3
devious_padlock.escape_tip: Tip: The witch from the Magic School can help you to remove padlocks if you do not have a high difficulty mode

remote_control.name: Remote Control
remote_control.description: Remote control lets allowed users to remotely change your appearance, now you don't need to be in the same room to change items of your friends. If remote control is disabled then no one can use it on you. Type "/dogs remote <member number>" to connect remotely.

devious_padlock_editor.additional_unlock_methods: In addition to the key, the padlock can be unlocked in other ways
devious_padlock_editor.base_lock_description: The padlock's owner (original applicator) may set the base padlock used in BC. This can reduce the triggers resulting from other users' tampering. Non-Exclusive base locks disables 'Member Numbers' keyholders & forces 'Minimum Role' to at least match the base BC lock.
devious_padlock_editor.minimum_role_description: The minimum role which will always have the key to the padlock. Must meet base lock minimum.
devious_padlock_editor.member_numbers_description: Member numbers which will always have the key to the padlock. Disabled if base lock is not 'Exclusive'
devious_padlock_editor.note_placeholder: You can leave a note that other DOGS users can see
devious_padlock_editor.zones_you_can_sync: Zones you can sync with choosen profile
devious_padlock_editor.zones_you_cant_sync: Zones you can't sync with choosen profile due limits
devious_padlock_editor.zones_to_sync: Zones to sync with choosen profile
devious_padlock_editor.zones_already_synced: Zones already synced with choosen profile
devious_padlock_editor.sync_description: Sync specified padlocks with specified profile
devious_padlock_editor.unlock_by_key_note: 1. By those who have the key to this padlock (Owner of padlock, those who fit the minimum role and those whose member numbers are on padlock)
devious_padlock_editor.unlock_by_timer_note: 2. When the timer expires (if it is set on padlock)
devious_padlock_editor.unlock_by_code_note: 3. When the correct code is entered (if padlock accepts codes)
